{"content":"Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6roSSC` — `keyEnvRef` hard-restricts env names to `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`

**Your preferred option is implemented**: the binding now accepts any name that is a valid env *reference* and drops the case check entirely.

`ProviderModelBinding.resolve` (`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) replaces the `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` regex with `_isValidEnvReference(name)`: non-empty (blank is already treated as absent), no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters (ASCII and C1). Case is deliberately unchecked — lowercase env names are legal on every host and were never validated before this PR, so a previously-working `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `"apiKeyEnvVar": "my_key"` and a queue `apiKeyEnv: my_key` keep booting (the queue boot is no longer bricked by a case rule). The error text no longer claims a name "is not an environment variable name": it now says the ref is *"not a usable environment variable reference (no whitespace, `\"=\"` or control characters)"* — a value-shaped string is the only thing still refused (S3 preserved: values never enter a binding).

Tests (`provider_model_binding_test.dart`):
- the old "rejects a lowercase key ref" pin is replaced by *"accepts a lowercase env name — a legacy apiKeyEnvVar/apiKeyEnv keeps booting"* (`keyEnvRef: 'my_key'` resolves and echoes);
- a new value-shape pin asserts `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` throw with the new, non-gaslighting message.

No uppercase-convention lint was added: the binding is a pure value object with no output channel, and the relaxed rule is documented on the resolver (the comment names the review as the source). Both production surfaces (`parseEnvProviderPreconfig` → `keyEnvRef`, `buildProviderQueueChain` → `keyEnvRef`) needed no edits — they only feed the relaxed validator.

{"content":"Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6roSSC` — `keyEnvRef` hard-restricts env names to `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`

**Your preferred option is implemented**: the binding now accepts any name that is a valid env *reference* and drops the case check entirely.

`ProviderModelBinding.resolve` (`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) replaces the `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` regex with `_isValidEnvReference(name)`: non-empty (blank is already treated as absent), no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters (ASCII and C1). Case is deliberately unchecked — lowercase env names are legal on every host and were never validated before this PR, so a previously-working `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `"apiKeyEnvVar": "my_key"` and a queue `apiKeyEnv: my_key` keep booting (the queue boot is no longer bricked by a case rule). The error text no longer claims a name "is not an environment variable name": it now says the ref is *"not a usable environment variable reference (no whitespace, `\"=\"` or control characters)"* — a value-shaped string is the only thing still refused (S3 preserved: values never enter a binding).

Tests (`provider_model_binding_test.dart`):
- the old "rejects a lowercase key ref" pin is replaced by *"accepts a lowercase env name — a legacy apiKeyEnvVar/apiKeyEnv keeps booting"* (`keyEnvRef: 'my_key'` resolves and echoes);
- a new value-shape pin asserts `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` throw with the new, non-gaslighting message.

No uppercase-convention lint was added: the binding is a pure value object with no output channel, and the relaxed rule is documented on the resolver (the comment names the review as the source). Both production surfaces (`parseEnvProviderPreconfig` → `keyEnvRef`, `buildProviderQueueChain` → `keyEnvRef`) needed no edits — they only feed the relaxed validator.

# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). {"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

{"content":"Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6roSSC` — `keyEnvRef` hard-restricts env names to `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`

**Your preferred option is implemented**: the binding now accepts any name that is a valid env *reference* and drops the case check entirely.

`ProviderModelBinding.resolve` (`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) replaces the `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` regex with `_isValidEnvReference(name)`: non-empty (blank is already treated as absent), no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters (ASCII and C1). Case is deliberately unchecked — lowercase env names are legal on every host and were never validated before this PR, so a previously-working `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `"apiKeyEnvVar": "my_key"` and a queue `apiKeyEnv: my_key` keep booting (the queue boot is no longer bricked by a case rule). The error text no longer claims a name "is not an environment variable name": it now says the ref is *"not a usable environment variable reference (no whitespace, `\"=\"` or control characters)"* — a value-shaped string is the only thing still refused (S3 preserved: values never enter a binding).

Tests (`provider_model_binding_test.dart`):
- the old "rejects a lowercase key ref" pin is replaced by *"accepts a lowercase env name — a legacy apiKeyEnvVar/apiKeyEnv keeps booting"* (`keyEnvRef: 'my_key'` resolves and echoes);
- a new value-shape pin asserts `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` throw with the new, non-gaslighting message.

No uppercase-convention lint was added: the binding is a pure value object with no output channel, and the relaxed rule is documented on the resolver (the comment names the review as the source). Both production surfaces (`parseEnvProviderPreconfig` → `keyEnvRef`, `buildProviderQueueChain` → `keyEnvRef`) needed no edits — they only feed the relaxed validator.

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — flag-over-preconfig/base-url joint revalidation (`_revalidatePartialOverride`)
- `lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart` — `_parseWire` extraction (CRAP)
- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — `_isModelIdRune` + C1 hardening; `_isValidEnvReference` key-ref policy
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `queueKindCatalogName` removed
- `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart` — `keyless`+`apiKeyName` mutual-exclusion rejection
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — stale keyless-pin comment corrected
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — flag-over-preconfig rejection ×2 + same-family pass guard
- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — C1 rejection fixtures; lowercase-accepted + value-shape key-ref pins
- `test/model_roles/roles_config_test.dart` — keyless+apiKeyName rejection test
- `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` — property assertions moved onto the surviving catalog seam
- `test/model_roles/model_resolver_test.dart`, `lib/src/cli/headless_provider_key.dart` — format only

## Test Coverage

TDD throughout — every production change preceded by a RED test:

- AC3/H2: `an explicit --model of another dialect over an ACTIVE FA_PROVIDER_* preconfig is rejected too` (the reviewer's exact repro — failed before the fix) + the `--base-url`-over-preconfig twin + same-family pass guard. `dart test test/cli/startup_test.dart` → **76 passed**.
- C1 hardening: `ctl\u0091x` / `id\u0085next` added to the id-shape rejection list (RED before). `dart test test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` → **34 passed**.
- Key-ref policy: lowercase `my_key` accepted; `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` rejected with the new message.
- keyless+apiKeyName: rejection test in `roles_config_test.dart` (RED before). Combined with `model_resolver_test.dart` → **66 passed**.
- Queue identity: `dart test test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` → **5 passed**.
- CRAP (local, `crap4dart` 0.11.0 = CI's pin, real subset coverage): `_takeConfigEntry` **13.13 → 11.00**, `validateModelIdShape` **13.00 → 6.00** (both 100% cov), `_isModelIdRune` 8.00, `_isValidEnvReference` 7.00, `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` 7.00, `_revalidatePartialOverride` 6.10 — all ≤ 12.00; `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched.
- `dart analyze` on all touched files — 0 issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on the touched set (pre-existing drifting files excluded by design).
- Full unit suite under CI's hostile ambient env (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=zai` + `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` + `FAH_PROVIDER` + `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`): **10551 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped**.

The iOS leg's network loss is infra-transient; every other red root cause is fixed above and CI re-runs on push.

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — flag-over-preconfig/base-url joint revalidation (`_revalidatePartialOverride`)
- `lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart` — `_parseWire` extraction (CRAP)
- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — `_isModelIdRune` + C1 hardening; `_isValidEnvReference` key-ref policy
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `queueKindCatalogName` removed
- `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart` — `keyless`+`apiKeyName` mutual-exclusion rejection
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — stale keyless-pin comment corrected
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — flag-over-preconfig rejection ×2 + same-family pass guard
- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — C1 rejection fixtures; lowercase-accepted + value-shape key-ref pins
- `test/model_roles/roles_config_test.dart` — keyless+apiKeyName rejection test
- `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` — property assertions moved onto the surviving catalog seam
- `test/model_roles/model_resolver_test.dart`, `lib/src/cli/headless_provider_key.dart` — format only

## Test Coverage

TDD throughout — every production change preceded by a RED test:

- AC3/H2: `an explicit --model of another dialect over an ACTIVE FA_PROVIDER_* preconfig is rejected too` (the reviewer's exact repro — failed before the fix) + the `--base-url`-over-preconfig twin + same-family pass guard. `dart test test/cli/startup_test.dart` → **76 passed**.
- C1 hardening: `ctl\u0091x` / `id\u0085next` added to the id-shape rejection list (RED before). `dart test test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` → **34 passed**.
- Key-ref policy: lowercase `my_key` accepted; `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` rejected with the new message.
- keyless+apiKeyName: rejection test in `roles_config_test.dart` (RED before). Combined with `model_resolver_test.dart` → **66 passed**.
- Queue identity: `dart test test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` → **5 passed**.
- CRAP (local, `crap4dart` 0.11.0 = CI's pin, real subset coverage): `_takeConfigEntry` **13.13 → 11.00**, `validateModelIdShape` **13.00 → 6.00** (both 100% cov), `_isModelIdRune` 8.00, `_isValidEnvReference` 7.00, `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` 7.00, `_revalidatePartialOverride` 6.10 — all ≤ 12.00; `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched.
- `dart analyze` on all touched files — 0 issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on the touched set (pre-existing drifting files excluded by design).
- Full unit suite under CI's hostile ambient env (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=zai` + `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` + `FAH_PROVIDER` + `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`): **10551 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped**.

The iOS leg's network loss is infra-transient; every other red root cause is fixed above and CI re-runs on push.

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".

- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.

`ProviderModelBinding.resolve` (`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) replaces the `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` regex with `_isValidEnvReference(name)`: non-empty (blank is already treated as absent), no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters (ASCII and C1). - the old "rejects a lowercase key ref" pin is replaced by *"accepts a lowercase env name — a legacy apiKeyEnvVar/apiKeyEnv keeps booting"* (`keyEnvRef: 'my_key'` resolves and echoes);
- a new value-shape pin asserts `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` throw with the new, non-gaslighting message.

No uppercase-convention lint was added: the binding is a pure value object with no output channel, and the relaxed rule is documented on the resolver (the comment names the review as the source). {"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — flag-over-preconfig/base-url joint revalidation (`_revalidatePartialOverride`)
- `lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart` — `_parseWire` extraction (CRAP)
- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — `_isModelIdRune` + C1 hardening; `_isValidEnvReference` key-ref policy
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `queueKindCatalogName` removed
- `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart` — `keyless`+`apiKeyName` mutual-exclusion rejection
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — stale keyless-pin comment corrected
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — flag-over-preconfig rejection ×2 + same-family pass guard
- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — C1 rejection fixtures; lowercase-accepted + value-shape key-ref pins
- `test/model_roles/roles_config_test.dart` — keyless+apiKeyName rejection test
- `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` — property assertions moved onto the surviving catalog seam
- `test/model_roles/model_resolver_test.dart`, `lib/src/cli/headless_provider_key.dart` — format only

## Test Coverage

TDD throughout — every production change preceded by a RED test:

- AC3/H2: `an explicit --model of another dialect over an ACTIVE FA_PROVIDER_* preconfig is rejected too` (the reviewer's exact repro — failed before the fix) + the `--base-url`-over-preconfig twin + same-family pass guard. `dart test test/cli/startup_test.dart` → **76 passed**.
- C1 hardening: `ctl\u0091x` / `id\u0085next` added to the id-shape rejection list (RED before). `dart test test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` → **34 passed**.
- Key-ref policy: lowercase `my_key` accepted; `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` rejected with the new message.
- keyless+apiKeyName: rejection test in `roles_config_test.dart` (RED before). Combined with `model_resolver_test.dart` → **66 passed**.
- Queue identity: `dart test test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` → **5 passed**.
- CRAP (local, `crap4dart` 0.11.0 = CI's pin, real subset coverage): `_takeConfigEntry` **13.13 → 11.00**, `validateModelIdShape` **13.00 → 6.00** (both 100% cov), `_isModelIdRune` 8.00, `_isValidEnvReference` 7.00, `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` 7.00, `_revalidatePartialOverride` 6.10 — all ≤ 12.00; `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched.
- `dart analyze` on all touched files — 0 issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on the touched set (pre-existing drifting files excluded by design).
- Full unit suite under CI's hostile ambient env (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=zai` + `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` + `FAH_PROVIDER` + `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`): **10551 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped**.

The iOS leg's network loss is infra-transient; every other red root cause is fixed above and CI re-runs on push.

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). {"content":"Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6roSSC` — `keyEnvRef` hard-restricts env names to `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`

**Your preferred option is implemented**: the binding now accepts any name that is a valid env *reference* and drops the case check entirely.

`ProviderModelBinding.resolve` (`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) replaces the `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` regex with `_isValidEnvReference(name)`: non-empty (blank is already treated as absent), no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters (ASCII and C1). Case is deliberately unchecked — lowercase env names are legal on every host and were never validated before this PR, so a previously-working `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `"apiKeyEnvVar": "my_key"` and a queue `apiKeyEnv: my_key` keep booting (the queue boot is no longer bricked by a case rule). The error text no longer claims a name "is not an environment variable name": it now says the ref is *"not a usable environment variable reference (no whitespace, `\"=\"` or control characters)"* — a value-shaped string is the only thing still refused (S3 preserved: values never enter a binding).

Tests (`provider_model_binding_test.dart`):
- the old "rejects a lowercase key ref" pin is replaced by *"accepts a lowercase env name — a legacy apiKeyEnvVar/apiKeyEnv keeps booting"* (`keyEnvRef: 'my_key'` resolves and echoes);
- a new value-shape pin asserts `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` throw with the new, non-gaslighting message.

No uppercase-convention lint was added: the binding is a pure value object with no output channel, and the relaxed rule is documented on the resolver (the comment names the review as the source). Both production surfaces (`parseEnvProviderPreconfig` → `keyEnvRef`, `buildProviderQueueChain` → `keyEnvRef`) needed no edits — they only feed the relaxed validator.

The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.

{"content":"Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6roSSC` — `keyEnvRef` hard-restricts env names to `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`

**Your preferred option is implemented**: the binding now accepts any name that is a valid env *reference* and drops the case check entirely.

`ProviderModelBinding.resolve` (`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) replaces the `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` regex with `_isValidEnvReference(name)`: non-empty (blank is already treated as absent), no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters (ASCII and C1). {"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — flag-over-preconfig/base-url joint revalidation (`_revalidatePartialOverride`)
- `lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart` — `_parseWire` extraction (CRAP)
- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — `_isModelIdRune` + C1 hardening; `_isValidEnvReference` key-ref policy
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `queueKindCatalogName` removed
- `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart` — `keyless`+`apiKeyName` mutual-exclusion rejection
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — stale keyless-pin comment corrected
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — flag-over-preconfig rejection ×2 + same-family pass guard
- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — C1 rejection fixtures; lowercase-accepted + value-shape key-ref pins
- `test/model_roles/roles_config_test.dart` — keyless+apiKeyName rejection test
- `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` — property assertions moved onto the surviving catalog seam
- `test/model_roles/model_resolver_test.dart`, `lib/src/cli/headless_provider_key.dart` — format only

## Test Coverage

TDD throughout — every production change preceded by a RED test:

- AC3/H2: `an explicit --model of another dialect over an ACTIVE FA_PROVIDER_* preconfig is rejected too` (the reviewer's exact repro — failed before the fix) + the `--base-url`-over-preconfig twin + same-family pass guard. `dart test test/cli/startup_test.dart` → **76 passed**.
- C1 hardening: `ctl\u0091x` / `id\u0085next` added to the id-shape rejection list (RED before). `dart test test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` → **34 passed**.
- Key-ref policy: lowercase `my_key` accepted; `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` rejected with the new message.
- keyless+apiKeyName: rejection test in `roles_config_test.dart` (RED before). Combined with `model_resolver_test.dart` → **66 passed**.
- Queue identity: `dart test test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` → **5 passed**.
- CRAP (local, `crap4dart` 0.11.0 = CI's pin, real subset coverage): `_takeConfigEntry` **13.13 → 11.00**, `validateModelIdShape` **13.00 → 6.00** (both 100% cov), `_isModelIdRune` 8.00, `_isValidEnvReference` 7.00, `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` 7.00, `_revalidatePartialOverride` 6.10 — all ≤ 12.00; `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched.
- `dart analyze` on all touched files — 0 issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on the touched set (pre-existing drifting files excluded by design).
- Full unit suite under CI's hostile ambient env (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=zai` + `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` + `FAH_PROVIDER` + `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`): **10551 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped**.

The iOS leg's network loss is infra-transient; every other red root cause is fixed above and CI re-runs on push.

{"content":"Thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6roSSC` — `keyEnvRef` hard-restricts env names to `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`

**Your preferred option is implemented**: the binding now accepts any name that is a valid env *reference* and drops the case check entirely.

`ProviderModelBinding.resolve` (`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`) replaces the `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$` regex with `_isValidEnvReference(name)`: non-empty (blank is already treated as absent), no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters (ASCII and C1). Case is deliberately unchecked — lowercase env names are legal on every host and were never validated before this PR, so a previously-working `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `"apiKeyEnvVar": "my_key"` and a queue `apiKeyEnv: my_key` keep booting (the queue boot is no longer bricked by a case rule). The error text no longer claims a name "is not an environment variable name": it now says the ref is *"not a usable environment variable reference (no whitespace, `\"=\"` or control characters)"* — a value-shaped string is the only thing still refused (S3 preserved: values never enter a binding).

Tests (`provider_model_binding_test.dart`):
- the old "rejects a lowercase key ref" pin is replaced by *"accepts a lowercase env name — a legacy apiKeyEnvVar/apiKeyEnv keeps booting"* (`keyEnvRef: 'my_key'` resolves and echoes);
- a new value-shape pin asserts `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` throw with the new, non-gaslighting message.

No uppercase-convention lint was added: the binding is a pure value object with no output channel, and the relaxed rule is documented on the resolver (the comment names the review as the source). Both production surfaces (`parseEnvProviderPreconfig` → `keyEnvRef`, `buildProviderQueueChain` → `keyEnvRef`) needed no edits — they only feed the relaxed validator.

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — flag-over-preconfig/base-url joint revalidation (`_revalidatePartialOverride`)
- `lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart` — `_parseWire` extraction (CRAP)
- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — `_isModelIdRune` + C1 hardening; `_isValidEnvReference` key-ref policy
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `queueKindCatalogName` removed
- `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart` — `keyless`+`apiKeyName` mutual-exclusion rejection
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — stale keyless-pin comment corrected
- `test/cli/startup_test.dart` — flag-over-preconfig rejection ×2 + same-family pass guard
- `test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` — C1 rejection fixtures; lowercase-accepted + value-shape key-ref pins
- `test/model_roles/roles_config_test.dart` — keyless+apiKeyName rejection test
- `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` — property assertions moved onto the surviving catalog seam
- `test/model_roles/model_resolver_test.dart`, `lib/src/cli/headless_provider_key.dart` — format only

## Test Coverage

TDD throughout — every production change preceded by a RED test:

- AC3/H2: `an explicit --model of another dialect over an ACTIVE FA_PROVIDER_* preconfig is rejected too` (the reviewer's exact repro — failed before the fix) + the `--base-url`-over-preconfig twin + same-family pass guard. `dart test test/cli/startup_test.dart` → **76 passed**.
- C1 hardening: `ctl\u0091x` / `id\u0085next` added to the id-shape rejection list (RED before). `dart test test/model_roles/provider_model_binding_test.dart` → **34 passed**.
- Key-ref policy: lowercase `my_key` accepted; `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` rejected with the new message.
- keyless+apiKeyName: rejection test in `roles_config_test.dart` (RED before). Combined with `model_resolver_test.dart` → **66 passed**.
- Queue identity: `dart test test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` → **5 passed**.
- CRAP (local, `crap4dart` 0.11.0 = CI's pin, real subset coverage): `_takeConfigEntry` **13.13 → 11.00**, `validateModelIdShape` **13.00 → 6.00** (both 100% cov), `_isModelIdRune` 8.00, `_isValidEnvReference` 7.00, `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` 7.00, `_revalidatePartialOverride` 6.10 — all ≤ 12.00; `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched.
- `dart analyze` on all touched files — 0 issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on the touched set (pre-existing drifting files excluded by design).
- Full unit suite under CI's hostile ambient env (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=zai` + `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` + `FAH_PROVIDER` + `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`): **10551 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped**.

The iOS leg's network loss is infra-transient; every other red root cause is fixed above and CI re-runs on push.

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — flag-over-preconfig/base-url joint revalidation (`_revalidatePartialOverride`)
- `lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart` — `_parseWire` extraction (CRAP)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files — 0 issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on the touched set (pre-existing drifting files excluded by design).

{"content":"# gh-1570 rework — round 2: review threads closed, CRAP ratchet back under

## Issues/Notes

The automated review on head `58227256` (REQUEST_CHANGES, 4 blocking / 2 important / 3 suggestions) plus three red CI legs. Disposition:

- **BLOCKING — AC3/H2 partial-override hole**: `--model` over an ACTIVE `FA_PROVIDER_*` preconfig skipped the joint revalidation (the guard required `faPreconfig == null`), so `gpt-5` booted onto `api.anthropic.com` — the exact H2 class. The preconfig **is** a binding: `_bootProvider` keeps its kind while `modelId = parsed.model ?? faPreconfig?.modelId` lets the flag win the model slot. The same hole applied to `--base-url` over a preconfig (the preconfig binding was validated with *its* endpoint).
- **BLOCKING ×2 — CRAP ratchet (red "CRAP + duplication" leg)**: `_takeConfigEntry` 13.13 and `validateModelIdShape` 13.00 vs the pinned 12.0 down-only threshold.
- **IMPORTANT — `keyEnvRef` `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`**: silently bricked previously-working lowercase env-name configs (`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` `apiKeyEnvVar` → parse error; queue `apiKeyEnv` → boot `_fail`).
- **IMPORTANT — `dart format` drift** in 4 PR-introduced spots (harness auto-commits bypassed the self-healing pre-commit hook).
- **SUGGESTIONS** (all three taken): production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` + its stale doc; `keyless: true` + `apiKeyName:` silently ignored in `ModelRef.fromYaml`; the stale `bin/fah_runapp.dart` comment claiming keyless "cannot pin a chain".
- **Red "Build iOS (debug, unsigned)"** — transient infra, not the diff: Xcode SPM lost the network downloading `dl.google.com/firebase/.../absl.zip` ("The network connection was lost"). No code change; the leg re-runs on push.
- The unrelated staged work in the shared checkout (gh-1568 `sm_merge_guard` + its CI self-test step) belongs to another loop — left untouched, out of this rework's scope.

## Approach

- **`lib/src/cli/startup.dart`** — the partial-override gate moved into `_revalidatePartialOverride(...)`: whenever the boot is NOT in explicit `--provider` manual control and either flag slot is set (`--model` or `--base-url`), the EFFECTIVE binding (flag slot winning; preconfig model/baseUrl when a preconfig is active, saved pair otherwise) is revalidated through the one validating constructor (`ProviderModelBinding.resolve`, provenance `flag`). A blank effective model is no binding to revalidate (`--base-url` over a model-less saved config still fails at the model gate, unchanged). This also keeps `resolveEffectiveCliArgs` itself at CC 7 / CRAP 7.00 — the inlined version would have pinned it exactly at the 12.0 ratchet ceiling.
- **`lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart`** — `case 'wire':` now delegates to `_parseWire(value)` like every other structured key (`_parseThinkingLevel`/`_parseInputList`/`_parseCapabilityInt` pattern). Behavior byte-identical; `_takeConfigEntry` CC 13 → 11.
- **`lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart`** — `validateModelIdShape` extracted its per-rune allowlist into `_isModelIdRune` (CC 13 → 6) and closed the C1 hole with it: the non-ASCII arm admits `rune >= 0x00a0` only, so U+0080–U+009F (NEL, CSI, …) are rejected and the doc's "no control characters" claim is now enforced. The `keyEnvRef` check follows the reviewer's preferred option: any valid env *reference* (non-empty, no whitespace, no `=`, no control characters) via `_isValidEnvReference`, case unchecked — lowercase `apiKeyEnvVar`/`apiKeyEnv` configs keep booting — and the error text stops claiming a name "is not an environment variable name" (values are still refused: S3 preserved).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart`** — production-dead `queueKindCatalogName` deleted; kind→catalog derivation lives only in `ProviderModelBinding.catalogRecord`/`resolveCliProviderSpec`. `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` re-pointed at that seam (same property values: unique kinds → their name, shared kind → `openai`; unknown kind → catalog `null`, rejection owned by the binding).
- **`lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`** — `ModelRef.fromYaml` rejects `keyless` + `apiKeyName` with a named config error (the parser's fail-loud pattern), instead of silently ignoring the key name.
- **`bin/fah_runapp.dart`** — the stale comment now states the AC8 rule (a keyless declaration pins too) instead of contradicting the pin below it.
- Format drift fixed on the four flagged files (`headless_provider_key.dart` import, `provider_model_binding.dart` blank line, `providers_queue_runtime.dart` one-line throw, `model_resolver_test.dart` wrapper); the three *pre-existing* drifting test files were deliberately NOT reformatted (scoped diff).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/startup.dart` — flag-over-preconfig/base-url joint revalidation (`_revalidatePartialOverride`)
- `lib/src/cli/env_provider_preconfig.dart` — `_parseWire` extraction (CRAP)
- `lib/src/model_roles/provider_model_binding.dart` — `_isModelIdRune` + C1 hardening; `_isValidEnvReference` key-ref policy
- `lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue_runtime.dart` — `queueKindCatalogName` removed

- `test/model_roles/roles_config_test.dart` — keyless+apiKeyName rejection test
- `test/model_roles/provider_identity_test.dart` — property assertions moved onto the surviving catalog seam
- `test/model_roles/model_resolver_test.dart`, `lib/src/cli/headless_provider_key.dart` — format only

## Test Coverage

TDD throughout — every production change preceded by a RED test:

- AC3/H2: `an explicit --model of another dialect over an ACTIVE FA_PROVIDER_* preconfig is rejected too` (the reviewer's exact repro — failed before the fix) + the `--base-url`-over-preconfig twin + same-family pass guard. `dart test test/cli/startup_test.dart` → **76 passed**.

- Key-ref policy: lowercase `my_key` accepted; `has space` / `KEY=value` / `tab\tref` rejected with the new message.
- keyless+apiKeyName: rejection test in `roles_config_test.dart` (RED before). Combined with `model_resolver_test.dart` → **66 passed**.

- `dart analyze` on all touched files — 0 issues; `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` clean on the touched set (pre-existing drifting files excluded by design).
- Full unit suite under CI's hostile ambient env (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE=zai` + `FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG` + `FAH_PROVIDER` + `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`): **10551 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped**.

The iOS leg's network loss is infra-transient; every other red root cause is fixed above and CI re-runs on push.
